column1: # Slovak. Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05, pending the three-vendor debate; not final. See l10n/README.md for each field.
# percent_style has a no-break space (U+00A0) between the number and the sign, so a label can't wrap them apart. decimal_style groups with U+00A0 too, never U+202F, which Saira lacks.
